newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka buys 61,000 T hard wheat under PL-480.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys 61,000 T hard wheat under PL-480.

text.p: Sri Lanka has bought 61,000 tonnes of U.S. hard wheat under Title 1 of the PL-480 programme, a senior government official said on Monday.
Sri Lanka bought one lot of 48,000 tonnes of wheat at $153.69 per tonne and another 13,000 tonnes at $154.60 per tonne for July delivery, said the official, who declined to be identified.
The two suppliers were Japan's Mitsubishi Corporation and Marubeni Corporation, the official said.
Sri Lanka tendered for the wheat last month and said the cost must not exceed $10 million under the PL-480 authorisation.
